name: Precoro
summary: Precoro is a purchasing platform with requisitions, purchase orders, receipts, invoice matching and approvals. Core starts at $499 a month and Automation at $999 a month, both billed annually, and Enterprise is sold by quote. Single sign-on and the supplier portal sit on the Automation plan or above.

facts.text: Precoro says approved purchase requests convert into purchase orders with no data re-entry, and documents route to approvers by department, amount, project or other custom criteria.
The supplier management page describes customizable vendor registration forms with approval workflows, and a supplier portal where vendors upload documents and update product catalogs.
Precoro says it is SOC 2 Type II, GDPR and CCPA compliant, and that SSO, IP whitelisting and US or EU servers are supported.
The pricing page lists PunchOut connectors for suppliers such as Amazon Business, Grainger and Home Depot.
Signing up means accepting the terms rather than signing a formal contract, and cancellation takes 30 days' notice with access until the billing period ends.

plans.name: Core
plans.notes: Starting price, billed annually. Requisitions, POs, receipts, invoices, 2-way and 3-way matching, approvals and catalogs

plans.name: Automation
plans.notes: Starting price, billed annually. Adds PunchOuts, intake management, supplier portal, vendor onboarding, RFPs, API access and SSO

plans.name: AP Module
plans.notes: Starting price, billed annually. Invoice processing and payments

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Adds unlimited users, IP whitelisting and US or EU server choice

hiddenCosts: Multiple Companies, Integrations, Concierge Setup and Dedicated Support are paid add-ons with no published price.
Prices are starting prices and the page does not say what raises them.
The pricing page names no free trial. It offers a demo.

contract.cancellation: Cancellation takes 30 days' notice, and access continues until the current billing period ends.
